cc's 0.1.8 state at the 18:00Z fold (date -u read before this was composed); supersedes doing 4. SP = the session scratchpad.
0123 v3 (with 0127, 0129, 0140) IS READY TO LAND, and held. vc approved v2 at 17:02Z and v3's interdiff at 17:34Z. v3 exists because the full suite on v2 failed two helpers.bats scans: a raw shasum in a test, and keep_case_twin's bare `mv --` lines, which are all `mv -f --` now and in the mv arm's known list. The full suite on 0ec1fbf + v3: 1..1694, 1694 ok, rc 0, 17:32:18Z to 18:00:05Z (full0123v3.tap). vc checked the Intent rebuild's migration: it changed nothing in the tree, so nothing needs excluding from land.sh.
LAND: `SP/land.sh SP/v3try SP/0123.v3final.patch <HEAD> SP/0123-commit.msg` (the message has no placeholders). Then close 0123, 0127, 0129 and 0140. For each, the body is `intent issues show <id> --json | jq -r .body`, plus SP/res/<id>.md with {COMMIT} filled; then `intent issues edit <id> --from <file>` and `intent issues close <id>`. Then vc's hook-stub upgrade may run (vc's todo 133).
0131+0137 v2, from the critic's third pass (0 critical, 7 warnings), in SP/rebase0131 (0ec1fbf + a scratch commit of 0123 v3 + 0131 uncommitted). To do:
(1) `return 2` becomes 3 in _clean_has_markers, and `-ne 3` in _clean_scan: contract.bats's literal-2 arm is red now.
(2) An unreadable candidate found by name is partial and named.
(3) A target/ holding only per-node dirs is a build tree.
(4) Under --dry-run, a --refuse-partial refusal is said at once, before any "would mark" line, and "handled as asked" is not printed above a refusal.
(5) "found by name" in clean.md:15, clean:230 and the arm at clean.bats:907.
(6) fullcycle.bats's preview assertions (:128, :133, :146) match the whole line.
(7) -mindepth 1.
(8) The markers that need no read come before the tag, and _clean_roots skips a tag beside .rustc_info.json.
(9) A tag with cargo's sentence plus extra text is not cargo's.
(10) clean.md:83's flag list, and fullcycle.md on a run: override.
(11) The cargo_tag helper at clean.bats:945.
(12) An arm for fullcycle's preview over a partial scan.
Then: update the Z6 and Z7 targets, rerun Z and P (32 of 32 killed on v1), fill 0131-commit.msg (ARMS: 21 new, the deps/ arm replaced, the flag arm renamed, fullcycle +1; red first: red0131b/c/d; CRITIC: three passes), run the full suite, and hand to vc with the interdiff.
FILE A NEW ISSUE, pre-existing and destructive (the same critic): clean splits names on newline and TAB, so a crafted name lists a tree outside the project, or the source dir out/ beside out<TAB>, for removal. And a crate holding .rustc_info.json (--target-dir .) is listed for removal as a build tree.
0139, in SP/rebase0139 (0139.v2.patch 8d6a8cb2 over a scratch commit of 0131 v1). Done:
- code, with 6 find-status reasons;
- 11 arms, red first 10 of 10 at the base, plus the scan;

- pages;
- rehearsal 362 of 363 (the one red is 0131's literal 2).
